Class Progress

java.lang.Object
world.Progress
public class Progress extends Object
What the player has achieved in a game: the reached checkpoints, the checkpoint to restart from, the obtained lights, the doors locked open and the number of hits. It outlives the World, which is rebuilt at each death, and is saved by SaveData.
